student_learning_goal: I can mix bills and coins to make amounts up to $50.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can mix bills and coins to make amounts up to $50.
header.character_watermark: Tappy and Lou in the top-right with bill stack and coin pouch. Small (~1.5in). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

parts.student_instructions: Draw 3 ways to make $25 mixing bills and coins.
parts.visual_layout: Three blank combo workspaces with $25 target labels.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 2 three-way combo layout for money worksheet, B&W line art. 3 blank workspaces, each labelled '$25 =' for drawing bills and coins.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS03_P1_25 at Part 1: keywords name the combo workspaces twenty-five task.

parts.answer_key: Any 3 valid combos (e.g., 1 twenty + 1 fiver; 2 tens + 1 fiver; 1 twenty + 5 loonies).

parts.student_instructions: For 3 combos, mark TRUE if total = $35.
parts.visual_layout: Three combo pictures with TRUE/FALSE circles each.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 2 true-or-false combo layout for money worksheet, B&W line art. 3 combos: 1) 1 twenty + 1 ten + 1 fiver (T=$35), 2) 3 tens + 1 fiver (T=$35), 3) 1 twenty + 1 ten (F=$30). Each with TRUE/FALSE circles.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS03_P2_TF at Part 2: keywords name the combos thirty-five check.

parts.student_instructions: Make $50 using the FEWEST bills + coins.
parts.visual_layout: An empty workspace with fifty target and a piece count line.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 2 fewest-pieces workspace for money worksheet, B&W line art. Blank workspace with '$50 =' label. Below: '___ pieces' answer line.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS03_P3_FEW at Part 3: keywords name the fewest pieces task.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, find $50 with no fifty bill.
teacher_notes: Lesson 3 consolidation. Formative — check mix creation.
